customer_name: China Mars Exploration Project (中国火星探测工程)
business_problem: China's Mars exploration program wanted a more immersive way to communicate with the public and explain the Zhurong rover's mission, but needed lifelike interaction, expressive animation, and multilingual conversational ability to make a science-outreach digital character convincing.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and the China Mars Exploration Project created a digital-human version of the Zhurong rover to turn aerospace outreach into a live interactive experience. The solution combines 4D scanning, high-fidelity 3D character production, lightweight neural-network driving, and multimodal AI for speech and language. In practice, the digital human can move, blush, flap its 'wings,' describe its instruments, and respond to audience questions during public events. Under the hood, Baidu's system binds scanned training data to 3D models, then uses machine learning to drive expressions and lip movements in real time with low latency. The same stack also mixes prebuilt expressions with AI-generated animation and supports multiple input modes, including text, voice, RGB camera facial control, and depth-camera capture. That gives the Mars program a reusable digital-human channel for science communication that feels more like conversation than scripted video playback.
products_used: Multimodal AI Speech and Language Stack

solution_components.name: 4D Scanning Technology
solution_components.role: Captures the high-precision training data needed to build and tune the digital human's visual behavior.

solution_components.name: 3D Avatar Production Technology
solution_components.role: Creates the rover's lifelike 3D body, expressions, and motion foundation for interactive presentation.

solution_components.name: Xiling Intelligent Digital Human Platform
solution_components.role: Runs the real-time digital-human experience and coordinates animation, dialogue, and rendering.

solution_components.name: Multimodal AI Speech and Language Stack
solution_components.role: Supports multilingual speech, understanding, and interaction for the digital-human outreach experience.

data_flow: Visual and motion data captured through 4D scanning is bound to the Zhurong digital-human model, where neural-network driving predicts expression and lip movement. Text, speech, or camera-driven input then triggers the platform's multimodal language stack, and the resulting animation and responses are rendered back to live audiences in real time.
business_outcome: The Mars exploration program gained a reusable digital-human outreach channel that can explain mission details interactively, make science communication more engaging, and broaden public interest in aerospace exploration.
metrics: Real-time expression and lip-movement prediction accuracy exceeded 98.5%.
architecture_clues: The solution blends prebuilt expressions with AI-generated expressions in real time rather than relying on canned animation only.
Multiple driving modes are supported, including text, speech, RGB-camera control, and depth-camera capture.
The digital human is positioned as a reusable science-communication channel, not just a one-off event animation.
evidence_quotes: Baidu and the China Mars Exploration Project jointly unveiled the world's first digital human for a Mars rover (original: 中国火星探测工程联合百度发布的，全球首个火星车数字人).
The digital human uses 4D scanning and high-fidelity 3D character-production technology (original: 百度智能云采用国内首创的4D扫描技术…基于百度智能云的影视级高精拟真3D人像制作技术、拟人化3D卡通形象制作技术).
A lightweight neural network predicts expressions and lip movements in real time with accuracy above 98.5% (original: 采用了轻量级的深度神经网络模型，能够实现端到端的表情和口型实时预测，准确率高于98.5%).
The system supports text-driven, voice-driven, RGB-camera facial driving, and depth-camera driving modes (original: 百度的数字人技术拥有文本驱动、语音驱动、普通 RGB 摄像头面部驱动、深度摄像头面部采集驱动共四种驱动方式).
